div.div: رَفُودٌ A she-camel that fills the [vessel called] رِفْد or رَفْد at one milking: (S, A, K:) or that is constantly over her milking-vessel: or that yields an uninterrupted supply of milk: (IAar, L:) or that aids her owners by the abundance of her milk: (TA in art. ركد:) pl. رُفُدٌ. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
